protocol: DNS over TCP (RFC 7766), authoritative query profile

target.runtime_assertion: knotd -V reports 3.6.2; source archive SHA-256 and release signature verified
target.scope: authoritative DNS query/response over TCP/5300 for one isolated test zone; UDP, TLS, QUIC, zone transfer, dynamic update, recursion, and DNSSEC signing excluded

fuzzer.name: AFLNet ProFuzzBench snapshot
fuzzer.dns_tcp_adapter: source/aflnet-dns-tcp.patch plus length-prefixed DNS/TCP request and response-state adapter
fuzzer.feedback: black-box DNS header states (QR, opcode, AA, TC, RCODE); helper bitmap is not Knot source coverage
